title: feat: add dark mode toggle to settings
hint: An honest feature PR. Does it really include the tests it mentions?
description:
Adds a dark mode toggle under Settings → Appearance.

- The choice is saved to localStorage and falls back to the OS preference.
- Applied through a `data-theme` attribute on `<html>`, so existing CSS variables just work.
- Includes tests for the `useTheme` hook.

Closes #212
